blocks.text: 11. Key Takeaways

items: CI/CD automates the steps between a code or data change and a fully deployed, updated model.
It exists to automate the entire manual deployment sequence already covered across this course.
Continuous integration runs automated checks whenever code or training scripts change.
A CI/CD pipeline can trigger a new training run automatically given a new data version.
Automated validation gates check a newly trained model's performance before it ever deploys.
Continuous deployment pushes a model that passes validation live, without manual triggering.
If a deployed model behaves badly, the pipeline can automatically roll back to the previous version.
CI/CD reduces manual error across the pipeline; manual steps remain reasonable for small projects.
